Alger, 10 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 10, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The National Higher School of Artificial Intelligence received a high-level delegation led by the CEO of Huawei Algeria. Discussions focused on strategic partnership and skills transfer in the digital sector.
Partenariat technologique et académique: Technological and academic partnership at the National Higher School of Artificial Intelligence
Dans le cadre de son ouverture sur l'éco: As part of its outreach to the socio-economic ecosystem, the National Higher School of Artificial Intelligence (ENSIA) hosted a significant delegation. The director of the institution, Mr. Abdel Malek Bessir, met with Mr. Tony Shi Xiaohua, CEO of Huawei Algeria, during a strategic working session dedicated to the future of innovation and digital technology in the country. This initiative reflects the school's commitment to connecting higher education and academic research with the demands of the economic market.
Durant cette réunion, les participants o: During this meeting, participants reviewed recent technologies related to artificial intelligence (AI). The company representative presented the group's vision and innovations in smart solutions. The speakers also evaluated joint projects already initiated by ENSIA and Huawei Algeria, while exploring new cooperation prospects.
Les axes de discussion ont englobé la co: The areas of discussion encompassed strengthening ties between the academic and industrial spheres, supporting national talents and young innovative project holders, and designing joint programs focused on practical applications of artificial intelligence. This visit demonstrates the mutual commitment of both entities to building a high-performing technological ecosystem in Algeria. By combining industrial expertise with the potential of ENSIA's skills, the partnership aims to make the institution a major player in the digital transition and the design of AI solutions adapted to economic challenges.
